R44AT.name: NONEXPANDING_DP_POLARITY_PRODUCT_KERNEL
R44AT.head: 8813c77564f4077cdce63b6a4ebf1e8cba71a7d4
R44AT.rule: exact Davis-Putnam eliminate v when p(v)*q(v)<=p(v)+q(v)
R44AT.proved_progress: full legal phase has polynomial charged work and polynomial live state; variable count strictly decreases
R44AT.hard_frontier: Monotone 3-Sat-(3,2) is NP-complete and every variable has 6>5, so the reducer has no legal first move

R44AU.name: FIXED_ADDITIVE_DP_BUDGET_META_BARRIER
R44AU.head: e8f67c0b8a27a11efa2ca3b4817b13c356f991b4
R44AU.theorem: For every fixed constant K>=0, the exact DP reducer p*q<=p+q+K has a polynomial legal phase but is not universal progress.
R44AU.polynomial_phase_reason: each step adds net at most K clauses; at most n steps; clause/literal state and charged work stay polynomial for fixed K
R44AU.barrier_reason: Darmann-Doecker prove Monotone 3-Sat-(k,k) NP-complete for every fixed k>=2. For any fixed K choose fixed k with k^2>2k+K; then no variable is eligible on that entire class.

closed_routes: selector OR merge as branch compression
selector-free exact CNF projection as universal polynomial route
nonexpanding p*q<=p+q DP as universal progress
every fixed additive allowance p*q<=p+q+K as universal progress
current_frontier.next_question: Find one genuinely non-DP exact polynomial invariant/transition for regular monotone exact-3-CNF hard cores, with polynomial state/work, strict descent and polynomial terminal evaluation.
current_frontier.preferred_testbed: Monotone 3-Sat-(k,k), starting from the smallest regular hard cores, while preserving exactness and no heuristic authority.
